news.headline: Week ahead: retailers + the Jackson Hole build-up

news.headline: Stripe to buy AI gateway OpenRouter for $7B+
news.why: OpenRouter routes across 400+ models (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Meta, DeepSeek) for ~8M developers — the plumbing a lot of AI apps run on. A >5x markup from its May valuation shows how strategic model-routing has become; relevant to anything you build on multiple model APIs.

news.headline: OpenAI previews 'Ultrafast' GPT-5.6 on Cerebras (~750 tok/s)
news.why: A limited API preview claims up to ~14x faster output — inference speed keeps jumping, which matters for agentic/real-time apps.

news.headline: Anthropic nudges its misalignment risk rating up a notch
news.why: Its August risk report moved catastrophic-misalignment from 'very low' to 'low' — citing rising uncertainty, not a failed test — and referenced an unreleased, more-capable internal model. A signal of how frontier labs are pacing releases.
